meta.name: Lovely Little Farm
meta.description: Nestled in lavender fields is a lovely little farm where sisters Jill and Jacky nurture and love all their animals—including the talking ones. Being a young farmer isn't easy, but every day brings adventure and a chance to grow.

videos.title: Begins
videos.overview: Jill decides to start her own farm in the family barn. But she discovers it's already occupied—by a bossy duckling.

videos.title: Sisters
videos.overview: Jill and Jacky's new baby brother arrives. The sisters can't cuddle him yet, so Jacky looks after a precious egg while Jill tends to Barbara the sheep.

videos.title: Babies
videos.overview: Jacky wants to name her new baby brother, but none of her suggestions work for the family, so she needs big sister Jill's help.

videos.title: Egg
videos.overview: The golden egg's gone missing, so Jill, Al, and Pickle search for it. But even with Tucker Pup's sniffing skills, they're always one step behind.

videos.title: Rainy Day
videos.overview: As heavy rain pours down, Jill has to rescue her lost sheep and stop her goats from creating a ruckus around the farm.

videos.title: Photo
videos.overview: Jill wants her animals in the new family photo. But getting them to look at the camera—and making sure Jacky stays clean—is hard.

videos.title: Hiccups
videos.overview: Jill accidentally drops the golden egg, and it starts to hiccup. When she can't help it stop, Jill wonders if she can be a good farmer.
